title: A Crisis in Peru Signals Trouble for South America

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，欢迎收听《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: A few weeks ago, when the president of Peru attempted an illegal power grab, the response was unexpected.
sentences.zh: 几周前，当秘鲁总统试图非法夺权时，各界的反应出人意料。

sentences.en: Thousands of citizens took to the streets in support of him.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的民众走上街头支持他。

sentences.en: Some protesters even died.
sentences.zh: 一些抗议者甚至因此丧生。

sentences.en: Today, I spoke with my colleague Julie Turkowicz about why such a divisive leader has had such fierce support and what it tells us about a new era of instability in South America.
sentences.zh: 今天，我与同事朱莉·图尔科维奇讨论了为何这样一位极具争议的领导人会拥有如此坚定的支持，以及这反映了南美洲动荡新时代的什么特征。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, December 22nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月22日，星期四。

sentences.en: Julie, hi.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，你好。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: You are in Peru right now.
sentences.zh: 你现在在秘鲁。

sentences.en: Tell me what's going on there.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们那里发生了什么。

sentences.en: So, Peru is mired in this political crisis that poses the biggest threat to its democracy in years.
sentences.zh: 秘鲁正深陷政治危机，这对该国多年来的民主构成了最大威胁。

sentences.en: And, you know, that says a lot because Peru is a country that has experienced a lot of political crisis.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这话说起来很有分量，因为秘鲁是一个经历过多次政治危机的国家。

sentences.en: For more than a week now, we have seen people protesting all across the country.
sentences.zh: 过去一周多以来，我们看到全国各地都有民众在抗议。

sentences.en: And these protests are a response to this pretty big event, the president being arrested and jailed.
sentences.zh: 这些抗议是对这一重大事件的回应，即总统被捕入狱。

sentences.en: And so, I went to the detention center where this president is being held.
sentences.zh: 因此，我去了关押这位总统的拘留中心。

sentences.en: And the scene is pretty remarkable.
sentences.zh: 那里的景象非常引人注目。

sentences.en: There are at least a thousand people there.
sentences.zh: 至少有一千人聚集在那里。

sentences.en: Many of them have come from rural areas hundreds of miles away.
sentences.zh: 他们中有许多人是从数百英里外的农村地区赶来的。

sentences.en: I met a 67-year-old woman who had traveled 20 hours by car to get to this detention center.
sentences.zh: 我遇到了一位67岁的妇女，她开车行驶了20个小时才到达这个拘留中心。

sentences.en: People are sleeping on these donated mattresses right next to the wall of the detention center.
sentences.zh: 人们睡在捐赠的床垫上，就在拘留中心的墙边。

sentences.en: There's these giant bulging bags of donated vegetables all over the place.
sentences.zh: 到处都是成堆的捐赠蔬菜，装在巨大的袋子里。

sentences.en: Supporters, many of them rural farmers, have come with produce for people to eat.
sentences.zh: 支持者们，其中许多是农村农民，带着农产品来供大家食用。

sentences.en: And it's really become this support village for the man these people call their president.
sentences.zh: 这里真的变成了一个支持村庄，为了他们口中的这位总统。

sentences.en: And these protests have really swelled and spread across the country.
sentences.zh: 这些抗议活动确实在全国范围内不断壮大和蔓延。

sentences.en: And some people are even dying in these protests.
sentences.zh: 甚至有人在抗议中死亡。

sentences.en: And now there are thousands of people all over the country calling for the release and the restitution of Pedro Castillo, their former president.
sentences.zh: 现在全国各地有成千上万的人呼吁释放并恢复前总统佩德罗·卡斯蒂略的职务。

sentences.en: Okay, so walk us through how we got here, Julie.
sentences.zh: 好的，朱莉，带我们梳理一下事情的来龙去脉吧。

sentences.en: Like, who is this president?
sentences.zh: 这位总统是谁？

sentences.en: And how did this all begin?
sentences.zh: 这一切是怎么开始的？

sentences.en: So, Pedro Castillo is from a rural part of Peru.
sentences.zh: 佩德罗·卡斯蒂略来自秘鲁的一个农村地区。

sentences.en: He was a teacher, a farmer, a union organizer.
sentences.zh: 他曾是一名教师、农民和工会组织者。

sentences.en: He's a campesino, which means he's a man from Peru's rural farming class.
sentences.zh: 他是一位“坎佩西诺”（campesino），意思是来自秘鲁农村务农阶层的人。

sentences.en: He has no background in politics.
sentences.zh: 他没有任何政治背景。

sentences.en: He had never held office before running for president.
sentences.zh: 在竞选总统之前，他从未担任过公职。

sentences.en: And he became a symbol of this idea that people from this class can move up, can enter into the circles of power.
sentences.zh: 他成为了一个象征，代表着这个阶层的人可以向上流动，可以进入权力圈。

sentences.en: You know, he broke through by running on this campaign that was about lifting up the lower class.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他通过竞选活动脱颖而出，主张提升下层阶级的地位。

sentences.en: He was going to overhaul the political and economic system and also invest a lot in health care and education,
sentences.zh: 他打算彻底改革政治和经济体系，并大力投资医疗和教育，

sentences.en: which are key issues for a lot of poor and lower middle class Peruvians.
sentences.zh: 这些都是许多贫困和中下阶层秘鲁人关心的核心问题。

sentences.en: He had this slogan that was no more poor people in a rich country.
sentences.zh: 他有一句口号：“富国不再有穷人”。

sentences.en: One thing that I think really propelled him toward victory was that his opponent was the best-known symbol of the Peruvian elite.
sentences.zh: 我认为真正推动他走向胜利的一个因素是，他的对手是秘鲁精英阶层最知名的象征。

sentences.en: Keiko Fujimori, she's a pro-free market candidate.
sentences.zh: 藤森惠子，她是支持自由市场的候选人。

sentences.en: She won't change a lot.
sentences.zh: 她不会做出太大的改变。

sentences.en: And she's the continuation of the same political system.
sentences.zh: 她是现有政治体系的延续。

sentences.en: She's a woman named Keiko Fujimori, and she is the daughter of a former authoritarian president in Peru who is, you know, associated with corruption.
sentences.zh: 她叫藤森惠子，是秘鲁一位前独裁总统的女儿，而那位前总统与腐败有着千丝万缕的联系。

sentences.en: Those who are voting for a change with Castillo remember the corruption and human rights violations during Alberto Fujimori's rule.
sentences.zh: 那些投票支持卡斯蒂略以寻求变革的人，还记得阿尔韦托·藤森统治期间的腐败和侵犯人权行为。

sentences.en: And Castillo wins, barely.
sentences.zh: 最终卡斯蒂略以微弱优势获胜。

sentences.en: He beat his right-wing rival by only 44,000 votes.
sentences.zh: 他仅以44000票的优势击败了右翼对手。

sentences.en: The margin was so small, and I think it really says something about how divided the country is.
sentences.zh: 差距如此之小，我认为这确实反映了这个国家的分裂程度。

sentences.en: But it was, at the time, really the clearest repudiation of the country's political establishment.
sentences.zh: 但在当时，这确实是对该国政治建制派最明确的否定。

sentences.en: So he was this real political outsider, it sounds like, from this peasant class you're describing.
sentences.zh: 听起来他确实是一位来自你所描述的农民阶层的政治局外人。

sentences.en: And that's very unusual in Peru.
sentences.zh: 这在秘鲁非常罕见。

sentences.en: And he narrowly wins this divisive election by a tiny margin after months of challenge from his opponent.
sentences.zh: 在经历了对手数月的挑战后，他以微弱优势赢得了这场充满分歧的选举。

sentences.en: And it's on this promise to work for all Peruvians.
sentences.zh: 他承诺要为所有秘鲁人服务。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So what's his presidency been like?
sentences.zh: 那么他的总统任期表现如何？

sentences.en: Like, has he been able to fulfill his promises to help the poor?
sentences.zh: 他是否兑现了帮助穷人的承诺？

sentences.en: Not at all, really.
sentences.zh: 完全没有。

sentences.en: He struggles really from the beginning to deliver or even begin to deliver on any of his promises.
sentences.zh: 他从一开始就难以兑现，甚至难以着手兑现他的任何承诺。

sentences.en: Like many past Peruvian presidents, he is mired in corruption scandals.
sentences.zh: 像许多前任秘鲁总统一样，他深陷腐败丑闻。

sentences.en: I think his case is particularly acute.
sentences.zh: 我认为他的情况尤为严重。

sentences.en: But prosecutors accuse him of leaving a criminal organization with lawmakers and his family to profit off government contracts.
sentences.zh: 检察官指控他领导了一个犯罪组织，与议员和家人勾结，从政府合同中牟利。

sentences.en: And they also accuse him of repeatedly obstructing justice, sometimes in plain view.
sentences.zh: 他们还指控他多次妨碍司法公正，有时甚至是在众目睽睽之下。

sentences.en: He churns through 80 ministers in 18 months.
sentences.zh: 他在18个月内更换了80位部长。

sentences.en: He fills many posts with political allies who lack relevant experience.
sentences.zh: 他任命了许多缺乏相关经验的政治盟友担任要职。

sentences.en: Some of them have faced investigations for corruption, domestic violence, murder.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人还面临腐败、家庭暴力和谋杀的调查。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And he's not only consumed by scandal, but many people say that he governs incompetently.
sentences.zh: 他不仅被丑闻缠身，许多人还说他执政无能。

sentences.en: And others say that Congress, which is really, you know, in large part made up of the elite and of the political establishment, and is really his adversary from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则认为，国会——很大程度上由精英和政治建制派组成——从一开始就是他的对手。

sentences.en: And, you know, he says is set on removing him from power from day one.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他说国会从第一天起就一心想把他赶下台。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So, like, his political enemies are out to get him.
sentences.zh: 所以，他的政治敌人一心想对付他。

sentences.en: That's what he says, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，他是这么说的。

sentences.en: So, Congress tries to impeach him on three different occasions.
sentences.zh: 因此，国会曾三次试图弹劾他。

sentences.en: The day that Congress is set to impeach him for the third time, on December 7th.
sentences.zh: 在国会定于12月7日第三次弹劾他的那天，

sentences.en: Tomamos la decisión de establecer un gobierno de excepción.
sentences.zh: “我们决定建立一个紧急政府。”

sentences.en: Castillo goes on television and makes this dramatic announcement.
sentences.zh: 卡斯蒂略出现在电视上，发表了这一戏剧性的声明。

sentences.en: Se dictan las siguientes medidas.
sentences.zh: “颁布以下措施。”

sentences.en: He says that he is disbanding Congress and creating a new government that will rule by decree.
sentences.zh: 他说他要解散国会，建立一个通过法令进行统治的新政府。

sentences.en: And the video of him doing this is pretty astounding.
sentences.zh: 他做这件事的视频非常令人震惊。

sentences.en: His hands are trembling.
sentences.zh: 他的手在颤抖。

sentences.en: He is essentially trying to remove his democratic mandate and put into effect a authoritarian mandate, one that rules by decree.
sentences.zh: 他本质上是在试图废除自己的民主授权，转而实施一种独裁授权，即通过法令统治。

sentences.en: And rule by decree?
sentences.zh: 通过法令统治？

sentences.en: Like, what's happening?
sentences.zh: 这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Like, what is he doing there?
sentences.zh: 他到底在做什么？

sentences.en: That effort is widely, widely marked as a coup or, as it is called in Latin America, an autogolpe, like a self-coup.
sentences.zh: 这一举动被广泛标记为政变，或者在拉丁美洲被称为“自我政变”。

sentences.en: But this effort, which is widely considered illegal and is outside the scope of the Peruvian constitution, didn't work because it was poorly orchestrated.
sentences.zh: 但这一被广泛认为是违法的、超出秘鲁宪法范围的举动，因为策划拙劣而失败了。

sentences.en: Castillo had no support.
sentences.zh: 卡斯蒂略没有任何支持。

sentences.en: His ministers resign en masse.
sentences.zh: 他的部长们集体辞职。

sentences.en: His vice president criticizes him.
sentences.zh: 他的副总统批评了他。

sentences.en: She calls this a golpe de estado, a coup.
sentences.zh: 她称这为“政变”。

sentences.en: And the military and the police decline to support him.
sentences.zh: 军队和警察也拒绝支持他。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So he's left out there on his own.
sentences.zh: 所以他被孤立了。

sentences.en: He's left out there on his own.
sentences.zh: 他被孤立了。

sentences.en: So from there, the top court declares the move unconstitutional.
sentences.zh: 此后，最高法院宣布这一举动违宪。

sentences.en: And within hours, he is ousted by Congress, as they had planned, arrested, and sent to this detention center on charges of rebellion.
sentences.zh: 几小时内，他正如国会计划的那样被罢免、逮捕，并以叛乱罪被送往拘留中心。

sentences.en: And his vice president is immediately installed as the new president.
sentences.zh: 他的副总统立即就任新总统。

sentences.en: From his dissolution of Congress to his arrest to the instatement of the new president, all of this happens in less than four hours.
sentences.zh: 从他解散国会到被捕，再到新总统就职，这一切发生在不到四个小时内。

sentences.en: And so the country is just, like, reeling and trying to figure out what the heck is going on.
sentences.zh: 整个国家都处于震惊之中，试图弄清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: That is just, like, lightning faSt.
sentences.zh: 这简直快如闪电。

sentences.en: Like, suddenly the president of the country is in jail.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，国家总统就进了监狱。

sentences.en: And is that when the protests begin?
sentences.zh: 抗议活动是从那时开始的吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Just a few days later, you start to see protests in the street.
sentences.zh: 仅仅几天后，街头就开始出现抗议活动。

sentences.en: And not just in Lima, the capital, but really all over the country, particularly in the rural areas that are Castillo's base.
sentences.zh: 不仅是在首都利马，而且遍及全国，特别是在作为卡斯蒂略大本营的农村地区。

sentences.en: And in some cases, these protests are peaceful.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，这些抗议是和平的。

sentences.en: But in other cases, protesters stage attacks against police stations, airports, factories, and they are blocking highways with, you know, burning tires, sharp rocks,
sentences.zh: 但在其他情况下，抗议者袭击警察局、机场、工厂，并用燃烧的轮胎、尖锐的石块封锁公路，

sentences.en: in a way that really hampers mobility all over the country.
sentences.zh: 这严重阻碍了全国各地的交通。

sentences.en: And, you know, it starts to become a real problem.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这开始成为一个真正的问题。

sentences.en: So the protesters are really paralyzing life in lots of places in Peru.
sentences.zh: 所以抗议者确实让秘鲁许多地方的生活陷入瘫痪。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, in response, the former vice president, a former ally of Castillo's, begins imposing these harsh rules to maintain order.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为回应，这位前副总统——卡斯蒂略的前盟友——开始实施严厉的规则以维持秩序。

sentences.en: She deploys the military and soldiers crack down on the protesters, often, again, in these rural areas.
sentences.zh: 她部署了军队，士兵们对这些抗议者进行了镇压，通常还是在那些农村地区。

sentences.en: These protests grow in size, and they result in these, you know, pretty significant encounters with the police and the military.
sentences.zh: 这些抗议活动的规模不断扩大，导致了与警察和军队之间相当严重的冲突。

sentences.en: There are hundreds of people injured, about 300 civilians, 300 police officers.
sentences.zh: 有数百人受伤，约300名平民，300名警察。

sentences.en: And up to today, 26 people have died.
sentences.zh: 截至今天，已有26人死亡。

sentences.en: So, Julie, let me make sure I understand this here.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，让我确认一下我是否理解了。

sentences.en: So, you've just described what sounds like a complete authoritarian power grab, right?
sentences.zh: 你刚才描述的听起来像是一场彻底的独裁夺权，对吧？

sentences.en: Effectively a coup.
sentences.zh: 实际上是一场政变。

sentences.en: And this guy hadn't even delivered on any of his promises to the poor constituents that supported him.
sentences.zh: 而且这家伙甚至没有兑现对支持他的贫困选民的任何承诺。

sentences.en: But yet here are all these protesters, in effect, kind of risking their lives to demand his release.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，这些抗议者还是冒着生命危险要求释放他。

sentences.en: So help me understand what's happening here.
sentences.zh: 帮我理解一下这里发生了什么。

sentences.en: Like, why are they doing this?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要这样做？

sentences.en: Well, for starters, more than half of the population would describe what happened just the way that you did.
sentences.zh: 首先，超过一半的人口会像你刚才那样描述所发生的事情。

sentences.en: An undemocratic authoritarian power grab that justified the response.
sentences.zh: 这是一场不民主的独裁夺权，因此政府的反应是正当的。

sentences.en: And almost all legal experts would also agree with that.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有的法律专家也会同意这一点。

sentences.en: But a recent poll here in Peru shows that 33% of the country supports what the poll called Mr. Castillo's coup.
sentences.zh: 但秘鲁最近的一项民意调查显示，33%的民众支持民调所称的“卡斯蒂略政变”。

sentences.en: And that number rises to 40% in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 在农村地区，这一比例上升到了40%。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: 40%, which is a lot.
sentences.zh: 40%，这可不少。

sentences.en: So, what is that, Julie?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是怎么回事，朱莉？

sentences.en: I also wanted to answer that question.
sentences.zh: 我也想回答这个问题。

sentences.en: And so, when I was outside of the detention center where Pedro Castillo is being held, this is what I was asking people.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我在关押佩德罗·卡斯蒂略的拘留中心外时，我问了人们这个问题。

sentences.en: Why do you support him?
sentences.zh: 你们为什么支持他？

sentences.en: Why do you want him back as president after he has attempted what is widely considered a coup?
sentences.zh: 在他尝试了被广泛认为是政变的行动后，你们为什么还想让他回来当总统？

sentences.en: And I spoke with this one woman, Delia, outside of the detention center.
sentences.zh: 我在拘留中心外与一位名叫黛莉亚的妇女交谈。

sentences.en: She was handing out breakfast for her fellow protesters.
sentences.zh: 她正在为抗议同伴分发早餐。

sentences.en: She said, look, I'm not very political.
sentences.zh: 她说，听着，我不太懂政治。

sentences.en: I'm a businesswoman.
sentences.zh: 我是一名商人。

sentences.en: But I came to support my brothers and sisters who are fighting day in and day out against the system.
sentences.zh: 但我来这里是为了支持我的兄弟姐妹，他们日复一日地与这个体制抗争。

sentences.en: And she actually said, the damn system.
sentences.zh: 她甚至说，“该死的体制”。

sentences.en: Delia said that, in her view, it's Congress who are the dirty actors here, not Castillo.
sentences.zh: 黛莉亚说，在她看来，国会才是这里肮脏的参与者，而不是卡斯蒂略。

sentences.en: They're the corrupt ones.
sentences.zh: 他们才是腐败的人。

sentences.en: And Congress has had it out for him since day one.
sentences.zh: 而且国会从第一天起就一直针对他。

sentences.en: They didn't want a leftist campesino in power.
sentences.zh: 他们不想让一个左翼农民掌权。

sentences.en: They didn't want someone humble in power that bothered them.
sentences.zh: 他们不想让一个卑微的人掌权，这让他们感到不安。

sentences.en: And they wanted him gone.
sentences.zh: 他们想让他下台。

sentences.en: And that is her view.
sentences.zh: 这就是她的观点。

sentences.en: And she says, this is an injustice.
sentences.zh: 她说，这简直是不公正。

sentences.en: She said that there is no way this guy would have pulled this political stunt.
sentences.zh: 她说，这家伙绝不可能搞出这种政治噱头。

sentences.en: And she is convinced that it must have been some wheeling and dealing elite that convinced him or swayed him or tricked him into trying to dissolve Congress and create this new government that would rule by decree.
sentences.zh: 她坚信，一定是那些精明的精英分子说服了他、左右了他，或者诱骗了他，让他试图解散国会并建立一个通过法令进行统治的新政府。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: That he was just duped.
sentences.zh: 他只是被骗了。

sentences.en: Yeah, she thinks he was tricked into doing something so stupid that he would have to be removed from power.
sentences.zh: 没错，她认为他被人诱导去做了如此愚蠢的事，以至于他不得不被罢免。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So it was all a plot against him.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都是针对他的阴谋。

sentences.en: That is exactly what she believes.
sentences.zh: 这正是她的想法。

sentences.en: And that is exactly what many people who are standing outside of that detention center believe.
sentences.zh: 这也正是许多站在拘留中心外的人所相信的。

sentences.en: Another common argument is, look, corruption is not new in Peru.
sentences.zh: 另一个常见的论点是，你看，腐败在秘鲁并不是什么新鲜事。

sentences.en: Presidents change with the seasons because there have been six presidents since 2016 in Peru.
sentences.zh: 总统换得比季节还快，因为自2016年以来，秘鲁已经换了六位总统。

sentences.en: And Delia described the politicians in Congress as a pyre of rats.
sentences.zh: 德莉亚把国会的政客们形容为一堆老鼠。

sentences.en: That is the maldito congreso, que es una tira de ratas.
sentences.zh: 也就是所谓的“该死的国会，就是一堆老鼠”。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Working only for themselves year after year.
sentences.zh: 年复一年，只为自己谋利。

sentences.en: That is an indictment.
sentences.zh: 这真是一项控诉。

sentences.en: Pyre of rats.
sentences.zh: 一堆老鼠。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's this idea of there's always politicking and backstabbing in politics, people trying to get their own.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，政治中总有政治博弈和背后捅刀，人们总是试图为自己争取利益。

sentences.en: There's this common saying in Peru, roba pero hace obra.
sentences.zh: 秘鲁有句俗话：“他贪污，但他干实事”。

sentences.en: I would say he robs, but he gets stuff done, right?
sentences.zh: 我会说，他虽然贪污，但他能把事情办成，对吧？

sentences.en: And so there's a very high tolerance, not that people want to have, but because of history, there's a sort of high tolerance for political malfeasance, let's say.
sentences.zh: 所以人们的容忍度很高，并不是说人们想要这样，而是因为历史原因，人们对政治腐败有一种很高的容忍度，姑且这么说吧。

sentences.en: So it's kind of like, look, all politicians are corrupt.
sentences.zh: 所以大家会觉得，看吧，所有政客都是腐败的。

sentences.en: But this guy, though corrupt, also stands for the people.
sentences.zh: 但这家伙虽然腐败，却也代表了人民。

sentences.en: Like, he could actually get something done for us.
sentences.zh: 就像是，他确实能为我们办成一些事。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Delia and many others say that they're not even his biggest fan.
sentences.zh: 德莉亚和许多其他人说，他们甚至算不上是他最忠实的粉丝。

sentences.en: But that hasn't stopped them from coming out to fight against this system that they believe has kept them down.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有阻止他们站出来，去对抗这个他们认为一直压迫他们的体制。

sentences.en: Delia made it clear.
sentences.zh: 德莉亚说得很清楚。

sentences.en: She said, I'm not a castellista.
sentences.zh: 她说，我不是卡斯蒂略的支持者。

sentences.en: I'm not in love with this guy.
sentences.zh: 我并没有爱上这个家伙。

sentences.en: But he had some good ideas.
sentences.zh: 但他确实有一些好的想法。

sentences.en: Investing in education, she wants her children to have the same opportunities as children in the upper classes.
sentences.zh: 投资教育，她希望自己的孩子能拥有和上层阶级孩子一样的机会。

sentences.en: So for her and for many others in Peru, Castillo's jailing has come to represent something much bigger than his own tenure in office.
sentences.zh: 所以对她和秘鲁的许多人来说，卡斯蒂略的入狱已经代表了比他个人任期重要得多的意义。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So, Julie, before the break,
sentences.zh: 那么，朱莉，在休息之前，

sentences.en: you talked about how these protests had really spread to many parts of the country and that they'd gone beyond Castillo in support of him as an individual, as a president.
sentences.zh: 你谈到了这些抗议活动是如何真正蔓延到全国许多地方的，而且它们已经超越了对卡斯蒂略个人的支持，超越了他作为总统的身份。

sentences.en: So what's really driving this?
sentences.zh: 那么，到底是什么在驱动这一切？

sentences.en: What are they about?
sentences.zh: 这些抗议是为了什么？

sentences.en: So these protests are really an economic story.
sentences.zh: 所以这些抗议实际上是一个经济故事。

sentences.en: Peru's economy for centuries has been centered around commodity exports, especially metals.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，秘鲁的经济一直以大宗商品出口为中心，尤其是金属。

sentences.en: And the desire for those metals really grew in the 2000s.
sentences.zh: 而对这些金属的需求在2000年代确实增长了。

sentences.en: Even when the world was in serious economic downturn, it still wanted to buy what Peru had to sell, the output of an enormous fishing fleet, mines and farMs.
sentences.zh: 即使在世界经济严重衰退时，人们仍然想购买秘鲁的产品，即庞大的渔船队、矿山和农场的产出。

sentences.en: The developing world, mostly China, needed these metals to power their growing infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 发展中世界，主要是中国，需要这些金属来推动他们不断增长的基础设施建设。

sentences.en: So you saw both rising prices of metals and rising demand for metals.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到了金属价格的上涨和金属需求的增加。

sentences.en: Peru is the world's second largest exporter of copper behind Chile.
sentences.zh: 秘鲁是仅次于智利的世界第二大铜出口国。

sentences.en: Peru's government predicts a growth rate of 6 percent, coupled with low inflation for 2010.
sentences.zh: 秘鲁政府预测2010年的增长率为6%，并伴随着低通胀。

sentences.en: And many governments, particularly in South America, were really flush with cash as a result of this boom.
sentences.zh: 许多政府，特别是在南美洲，由于这场繁荣，确实现金充裕。

sentences.en: In Brazil, Peru and Uruguay, GDP growth this year is expected to exceed 7 percent.
sentences.zh: 在巴西、秘鲁和乌拉圭，今年的GDP增长预计将超过7%。

sentences.en: Some governments used this extra revenue to support programs for the poor.
sentences.zh: 一些政府利用这笔额外收入来支持针对穷人的项目。

sentences.en: The healthy economy has benefited Peruvians like Wilmer Gonzalo.
sentences.zh: 健康的经济使像威尔默·贡萨洛这样的秘鲁人受益。

sentences.en: He used to be a street vendor.
sentences.zh: 他曾经是一名街头小贩。

sentences.en: Now he's a shopkeeper, optimistic, with a strong stake in his country's economic future.
sentences.zh: 现在他是一名店主，充满乐观，对国家的经济未来有着深切的投入。

sentences.en: To be sure, this wealth did not flow to every part of the country.
sentences.zh: 当然，这些财富并没有流向全国的每一个角落。

sentences.en: And this wealth did not flow to every part of the region.
sentences.zh: 这些财富也没有流向该地区的每一个部分。

sentences.en: And so many of the rural poor were left wondering, where is our piece of this?
sentences.zh: 所以许多农村地区的穷人不禁想问，我们那份在哪里？

sentences.en: Where is our piece of the wealth?
sentences.zh: 我们那份财富在哪里？

sentences.en: So this was something that was happening broadly throughout the region.
sentences.zh: 所以这在整个地区都在发生。

sentences.en: For sure, 100 percent.
sentences.zh: 当然，百分之百。

sentences.en: But what you saw was that, you know, amid this boom in the price of metals and oil,
sentences.zh: 但你所看到的是，你知道，在金属和石油价格繁荣的背景下，

sentences.en: Latin America was suddenly in the middle of this history-making transformation.
sentences.zh: 拉丁美洲突然处于这场具有历史意义的变革之中。

sentences.en: And inequality was shrinking like never before.
sentences.zh: 不平等现象正在以前所未有的速度缩小。

sentences.en: And you saw over time, many people finally having a toehold on the middle class.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，你看到许多人终于在中间阶层站稳了脚跟。

sentences.en: And over the last 20 years, we've really seen that millions of families have marched out of poverty in what is definitely one of the most unequal regions in the world.
sentences.zh: 在过去的20年里，我们确实看到数百万家庭摆脱了贫困，这绝对是世界上最不平等的地区之一。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So this commodity boom over the better part of two decades, which was helped in part by this rise of a booming China, actually grew these economies in this really profound way.
sentences.zh: 所以，这近二十年的大宗商品繁荣，在一定程度上得益于中国经济的崛起，实际上以一种非常深刻的方式推动了这些经济体的发展。

sentences.en: And as a consequence, people all over the region are lifted out of poverty.
sentences.zh: 结果，整个地区的人们都摆脱了贫困。

sentences.en: So how long does that go on, this economic boon?
sentences.zh: 那么，这种经济繁荣能持续多久？

sentences.en: By 2014, prices of these commodities began to fall pretty sharply, and the region began tumbling.
sentences.zh: 到2014年，这些大宗商品的价格开始急剧下跌，该地区开始走下坡路。

sentences.en: All of these economies started to feel it.
sentences.zh: 所有这些经济体都开始感受到这一点。

sentences.en: Peru, Colombia, Brazil.
sentences.zh: 秘鲁、哥伦比亚、巴西。

sentences.en: Brazil, the momentum toward this greater mobility that we're talking about had begun to slow and in some cases even move backward.
sentences.zh: 巴西，我们所谈论的这种向更大流动性发展的势头已经开始放缓，在某些情况下甚至出现了倒退。

sentences.en: But, Julia, I don't completely understand because there had been so many years of economic rise, right?
sentences.zh: 但是，朱莉，我不太明白，因为已经经历了这么多年的经济增长，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, why do just a couple of years of commodity declines mean that suddenly, you know, people's fortunes changed so dramatically?
sentences.zh: 为什么仅仅几年的大宗商品下滑就意味着人们的命运突然发生了如此剧烈的变化？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's really important to point out that the economic toehold people had on the middle class was really fragile.
sentences.zh: 所以非常重要的一点是，人们在中间阶层站稳的脚跟其实是非常脆弱的。

sentences.en: Many people in Peru, but also in other countries in South and Latin America, had informal jobs, which means that they didn't have a contract or guarantees of continued work.
sentences.zh: 秘鲁以及南美和拉丁美洲其他国家的许多人从事的是非正式工作，这意味着他们没有合同或持续工作的保障。

sentences.en: And they might work selling food on the street, or they might work in a shop, but with no formal contract, and they're paid every single day.
sentences.zh: 他们可能在街上卖食物，或者在商店工作，但没有正式合同，每天领工资。

sentences.en: And so the small amount of wealth that people had built up to maybe send their kid to a university could be wiped out in a single day, honestly,
sentences.zh: 所以，人们积攒的那点财富，本来可能用来送孩子上大学，老实说，可能在一天之内就化为乌有，

sentences.en: if a family member has an unexpected sickness, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果家里有人突然生病的话。

sentences.en: And so what you really saw is that people began to lose jobs, they began to lose whatever wealth they had accumulated,
sentences.zh: 所以你真正看到的是，人们开始失业，开始失去他们积累的任何财富，

sentences.en: and it became quite clear that these gains had been built on quicksand.
sentences.zh: 而且很明显，这些收益是建立在流沙之上的。

sentences.en: Okay, so people's fortunes changed pretty quickly because they didn't have a stronghold on the middle class.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以人们的命运变化得很快，因为他们在中间阶层并没有稳固的地位。

sentences.en: So what happened next?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Then comes the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 然后是疫情。

sentences.en: This is a swift kick to the region when it's already down.
sentences.zh: 这对该地区来说是雪上加霜的沉重一击。

sentences.en: The virus ravages Peru.
sentences.zh: 病毒摧毁了秘鲁。

sentences.en: Peru is the country with the highest documented per capita COVID death toll in the world.
sentences.zh: 秘鲁是世界上人均新冠死亡人数记录最高的国家。

sentences.en: Wow, really?
sentences.zh: 哇，真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's hard to overstate the toll that the virus took both on individual families as people died, as well as on the economy in general.
sentences.zh: 是的，很难夸大这种病毒对个人家庭（随着人们死亡）以及整个经济造成的损失。

sentences.en: You had this already high poverty rate rise by nearly 10%.
sentences.zh: 你本来就已经很高的贫困率又上升了近10%。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And the mining industry is hobbled.
sentences.zh: 采矿业也陷入了困境。

sentences.en: The demand for tourism and local services, of course, evaporates.
sentences.zh: 旅游业和本地服务的需求当然也蒸发了。

sentences.en: And we saw something really similar in other countries.
sentences.zh: 我们在其他国家也看到了非常类似的情况。

sentences.en: You know, at the time, I was reporting in Colombia, and I interviewed teenagers who had started working as sex workers to make money for their families,
sentences.zh: 你知道，当时我在哥伦比亚报道，我采访了一些为了养家糊口而开始从事性工作的青少年，

sentences.en: boys who started selling drugs to feed their brothers and sisters, families who couldn't pay their rent.
sentences.zh: 为了养活兄弟姐妹而开始卖毒品的男孩，付不起房租的家庭。

sentences.en: And I really heard these kinds of stories over and over again in the region.
sentences.zh: 我在该地区一遍又一遍地听到这样的故事。

sentences.en: So, Julie, how does all of this translate politically, this economic collapse?
sentences.zh: 那么，朱莉，这一切在政治上是如何转化的，这种经济崩溃？

sentences.en: So, what we're already seeing in the region is anger over these sort of unfulfilled promises, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，我们已经在该地区看到的是对这些未兑现承诺的愤怒，对吧？

sentences.en: This idea that this economic boom didn't really pan out for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 这种经济繁荣并没有真正让很多人受益的想法。

sentences.en: And then you see this momentum growing to vote out incumbents.
sentences.zh: 然后你看到这种投票罢免现任者的势头在增长。

sentences.en: What this created was something of a rise in the left.
sentences.zh: 这造成了某种左翼势力的崛起。

sentences.en: By January, the six most populous countries in Latin America will be run by people who claim to be part of the left.
sentences.zh: 到一月份，拉丁美洲人口最多的六个国家将由自称是左翼的人管理。

sentences.en: At the same time, I think it's really important to point out that this isn't really like a leftward move.
sentences.zh: 同时，我认为非常重要的一点是，这并不完全是一场向左转的运动。

sentences.en: It's not that everybody suddenly loves the left or believes in the left.
sentences.zh: 并不是每个人都突然热爱左翼或信仰左翼。

sentences.en: What we see is that people are angry at incumbents, and they want the incumbents out.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是，人们对现任者感到愤怒，他们想把现任者赶下台。

sentences.en: They want the establishment out.
sentences.zh: 他们想把建制派赶下台。

sentences.en: Okay, so there's this effectively revolution of rising expectations going on all over the region, right?
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以整个地区实际上正在发生一场期望值上升的革命，对吧？

sentences.en: People are used to hoping for that middle class.
sentences.zh: 人们习惯于对中产阶级抱有希望。

sentences.en: They had a toehold.
sentences.zh: 他们曾经站稳了脚跟。

sentences.en: They have a taste of it.
sentences.zh: 他们尝到了甜头。

sentences.en: And suddenly that's yanked away, and they're really angry.
sentences.zh: 突然间这一切被夺走了，他们非常愤怒。

sentences.en: And that is translating into increased political demands on their part, and as a consequence, increased political chaos and upheaval on the part of the governments,
sentences.zh: 这正转化为他们对政治要求的增加，结果导致政府方面、投票和选举方面出现了更多的政治混乱和动荡。

sentences.en: on the part of the voting and the elections.
sentences.zh: 在投票和选举方面。

sentences.en: And Castillo comes in on that wave.
sentences.zh: 而卡斯蒂略正是乘着这股浪潮上台的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So where are we right now, Julie, in terms of Peru's political crisis?
sentences.zh: 那么朱莉，就秘鲁的政治危机而言，我们现在处于什么阶段？

sentences.en: Like, what is happening now?
sentences.zh: 现在发生了什么？

sentences.en: So protests continue.
sentences.zh: 抗议活动仍在继续。

sentences.en: They've been going on for almost two weeks.
sentences.zh: 已经持续了近两周了。

sentences.en: Castillo himself is still in jail.
sentences.zh: 卡斯蒂略本人仍被关在监狱里。

sentences.en: He faces charges of rebellion, and he will be in detention for at least 18 months while his case is sorted out.
sentences.zh: 他面临叛乱指控，在案件审理期间，他至少要被拘留18个月。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: And at least 26 people have died, and the country is really in mourning.
sentences.zh: 至少有26人死亡，整个国家确实处于哀悼之中。

sentences.en: And Julie, how are people dying?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，人们是怎么死的？

sentences.en: I mean, is this the government going out and mowing down a bunch of peaceful protesters in a march, or is this just general mayhem stampede type thing?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是政府出去射杀了一群和平抗议的游行者，还是只是一般的混乱踩踏事件？

sentences.en: In a lot of cases, human rights groups are accusing the police and the military of disproportionate use of force.
sentences.zh: 在很多情况下，人权组织指责警察和军队过度使用武力。

sentences.en: In one of the most dramatic cases in a city called Ayacucho, nine people died in a matter of hours at the airport where they had gone to proteSt.
sentences.zh: 在阿亚库乔市发生的最具戏剧性的案例中，有9人在机场的几个小时内死亡，他们当时去那里抗议。

sentences.en: A video that was confirmed for us by local officials shows soldiers pointing guns at body level, and also shows lots of horribly injured people in the streets.
sentences.zh: 一段经当地官员向我们证实的视频显示，士兵们用枪指向人体高度，还显示街上有许多受重伤的人。

sentences.en: My photographer colleague and my other colleagues in Lima, we woke up that morning and we knew immediately that we had to go to Ayacucho.
sentences.zh: 我的摄影师同事和我在利马的其他同事，那天早上醒来时，我们立刻就知道必须去阿亚库乔。

sentences.en: So we got in the car, we drove 10 hours across the country, and the next day, I find the most intense funeral that I have ever witnessed.
sentences.zh: 所以我们上了车，开车穿越全国10个小时，第二天，我参加了我所见过的最激烈的葬礼。

sentences.en: This was a funeral for two different protesters who had died.
sentences.zh: 这是一场为两名死去的抗议者举行的葬礼。

sentences.en: They were among the nine killed.
sentences.zh: 他们是九名遇难者中的两位。

sentences.en: One was Clemmer, who was 22, and the other was Christopher, who was just 15.
sentences.zh: 一个是22岁的克莱默，另一个是年仅15岁的克里斯托弗。

sentences.en: Both came from poor families.
sentences.zh: 两人都来自贫困家庭。

sentences.en: Both had been at this protest at the airport.
sentences.zh: 两人都参加了机场的那场抗议活动。

sentences.en: It was a long, long sort of series of different kinds of processions and rituals.
sentences.zh: 这是一系列漫长而复杂的各种游行和仪式。

sentences.en: And you had this mass delivered partly in Quechua, which is the indigenous language that many people in this region speak.
sentences.zh: 弥撒部分是用克丘亚语进行的，这是该地区许多人说的土著语言。

sentences.en: You had Clemmer's mother just wailing.
sentences.zh: 克莱默的母亲一直在哀号。

sentences.en: I mean, just wailing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一直在哀号。

sentences.en: I was so worried that she was going to pass out at every moment.
sentences.zh: 我当时非常担心她随时会晕倒。

sentences.en: And you had so much music.
sentences.zh: 而且有很多音乐。

sentences.en: There was an orchestra of saxophones.
sentences.zh: 有一个萨克斯管管弦乐队。

sentences.en: There were boys, little boys on these traditional druMs.
sentences.zh: 还有一些小男孩在敲传统的鼓。

sentences.en: The drums were like as big as these little boys.
sentences.zh: 鼓和这些小男孩一样大。

sentences.en: And these were the kinds of drums that Clemmer used to play.
sentences.zh: 这些就是克莱默过去常敲的那种鼓。

sentences.en: He was in a traditional dance group.
sentences.zh: 他曾在一个传统舞蹈团里。

sentences.en: There were these women who were singing songs in Quechua.
sentences.zh: 还有一些妇女在用克丘亚语唱歌。

sentences.en: These high-pitched songs that really like hit you right to your core.
sentences.zh: 那些高亢的歌声真的直击你的内心。

sentences.en: And I asked like, what does it mean?
sentences.zh: 我当时问，这到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: What are you saying?
sentences.zh: 你在说什么？

sentences.en: And this young woman just screamed to me, justice, justice, justice.
sentences.zh: 然后这位年轻女子对着我大喊：正义，正义，正义。

sentences.en: So at the funeral, I met this man named Victor.
sentences.zh: 在葬礼上，我遇到了一个叫维克多的人。

sentences.en: He was the uncle of Christopher, the 15-year-old.
sentences.zh: 他是15岁的克里斯托弗的叔叔。

sentences.en: And I really wanted to know what Christopher was like.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想了解克里斯托弗是个什么样的人。

sentences.en: But I could barely get him to talk about Christopher because all he wanted to talk about were the larger political reasons that he was at this funeral.
sentences.zh: 但我几乎无法让他谈论克里斯托弗，因为他一心只想谈论他参加这场葬礼背后更宏大的政治原因。

sentences.en: What he told me was that his nephew's reason for protesting and his own reason for protesting was the same.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他侄子抗议的理由和他自己抗议的理由是一样的。

sentences.en: And it was to reject the political elites in Lima.
sentences.zh: 那就是拒绝利马的政治精英。

sentences.en: And by political elites, he means Congress.
sentences.zh: 他所说的政治精英，指的是国会。

sentences.en: He means the owners of big companies who make lots of money by exporting the country's riches.
sentences.zh: 他指的是那些通过出口国家财富赚取巨额利润的大公司老板。

sentences.en: And he really links the grief of his family to this larger political grief and frustration that has gone on not just for decades, but for centuries in Peru.
sentences.zh: 他确实将家人的悲痛与这种更宏大的政治悲痛和挫败感联系在一起，这种情绪在秘鲁不仅持续了几十年，甚至几个世纪。

sentences.en: Like what had happened had just tapped into this collective fury about their political plight.
sentences.zh: 就好像发生的事情触动了他们对政治困境的集体愤怒。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: The depth of the pain that we saw over the weekend was people not just crying because they lost their son,
sentences.zh: 我们周末看到的痛苦深度，不仅仅是因为人们失去了儿子而哭泣，

sentences.en: but because they have been suffering from years of what they consider injustices.
sentences.zh: 更是因为他们多年来一直遭受着他们认为的不公正待遇。

sentences.en: And there was this outpouring, not just for these two young men, but for the social situation of this entire community.
sentences.zh: 这种情感的宣泄，不仅是为了这两名年轻人，也是为了整个社区的社会现状。

sentences.en: So, Julie, what's going to happen?
sentences.zh: 那么，朱莉，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: I mean, has the chance for political change in Peru vanished?
sentences.zh: 我是说，秘鲁政治变革的机会消失了吗？

sentences.en: We're in a new moment.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于一个新的时刻。

sentences.en: People have seen opportunity.
sentences.zh: 人们已经看到了机会。

sentences.en: This has accelerated their dissatisfaction.
sentences.zh: 这加剧了他们的不满。

sentences.en: And so, you know, in Peru, these protests might die down.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，在秘鲁，这些抗议活动可能会平息。

sentences.en: But if something doesn't address these fundamental issues of poverty and inequality, this will be the political climate for a long time.
sentences.zh: 但如果不能解决贫困和不平等这些根本问题，这将是未来很长一段时间的政治气候。

sentences.en: Julie, thank you.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的消息。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Ukraine's president, Vladimir Zelensky, visited Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 周三，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基访问了华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: It was his first trip abroad since Russia invaded his country 10 months ago.
sentences.zh: 这是他自10个月前俄罗斯入侵其国家以来的首次出国访问。

sentences.en: President, great honor for me to be here.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，能来到这里我深感荣幸。

sentences.en: You're a journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 你是一名记者。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Zelensky made the trip to ask for more aid for his war-torn country.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基此行是为了请求为他饱受战争蹂躏的国家提供更多援助。

sentences.en: He met in the Oval Office with President Biden, who told him that the Ukrainian people, quote,
sentences.zh: 他在椭圆形办公室会见了拜登总统，拜登称乌克兰人民，引用原话，

sentences.en: inspire the world, and accused Russian President Vladimir Putin, who's been launching attacks on Ukraine's power grid, of trying to, quote, use winter as a weapon.
sentences.zh: 激励了全世界，并指责一直在对乌克兰电网发动袭击的俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京试图，引用原话，将冬天作为武器。

sentences.en: The main issue during my today's talks is to strengthen Ukraine next year.
sentences.zh: 我今天会谈的主要议题是加强乌克兰明年的实力。

sentences.en: Later, Zelensky gave a speech before a joint session of Congress in a bid to rally support for Ukraine among the American political class.
sentences.zh: 随后，泽连斯基在国会联席会议上发表了演讲，旨在争取美国政界对乌克兰的支持。

sentences.en: And the Biden administration announced on Wednesday that it would include a cutting-edge American air defense system in its aid to Ukraine to help guard against Russian attacks.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府周三宣布，将在对乌援助中包括一套尖端的美国防空系统，以帮助抵御俄罗斯的袭击。

sentences.en: And Benjamin Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving prime minister, announced on Wednesday that he had succeeded in forming a coalition government.
sentences.zh: 以色列任职时间最长的总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡周三宣布，他已成功组建联合政府。

sentences.en: Once finalized and ratified by parliament in the coming days, the coalition will return Netanyahu to office just 18 months after he left it.
sentences.zh: 一旦在未来几天内由议会最终批准，该联盟将使内塔尼亚胡在离职仅18个月后重返政坛。

sentences.en: He will be at the helm of the most right-wing government in Israeli history.
sentences.zh: 他将掌舵以色列历史上最右翼的政府。

sentences.en: His reliance on far-right factions to return to power has already raised concerns that Israel will drift away from liberal democracy.
sentences.zh: 他依靠极右翼派系重掌权力，已经引发了人们对以色列将偏离自由民主的担忧。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Nina Feldman, Carlos Prieto, and Mary Wilson, with help from Jessica Chung and Rochelle Banja.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由妮娜·费尔德曼、卡洛斯·普列托和玛丽·威尔逊制作，杰西卡·钟和罗谢尔·班贾提供了协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Liz O'Balen, with help from Lisa Chow.
sentences.zh: 由莉兹·奥巴伦编辑，丽莎·周提供了协助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Marianne Lozano, Dan Powell, and Rowan Nemisto.
sentences.zh: 包含玛丽安·洛萨诺、丹·鲍威尔和罗文·内米斯托的原创音乐。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean, do they blackout?
sentences.zh: 我不是说，他们会昏倒吗？

sentences.en: To go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.en: Who's so different?
sentences.zh: 谁这么与众不同？

sentences.en: have a good vaccine?
sentences.zh: 有好的疫苗吗？

sentences.en: Come on.
sentences.zh: 拜托。
